description: This file defines the GuardrailsAI class, a custom guardrail implementation for use with large language models in a Litellm project. It includes methods for making API requests to GuardrailsAI, processing input messages, and handling guardrail validation in various stages of API calls.

classes.name: GuardrailsAIResponse
classes.description: TypedDict representing the response from GuardrailsAI API, including call ID, raw output, validated output, and validation status.

classes.name: InferenceData
classes.description: TypedDict for storing inference data such as name, shape, data content, and data type.

classes.name: GuardrailsAIResponsePreCall
classes.description: TypedDict representing the pre-call response structure from GuardrailsAI, including model info and output data.

classes.name: GuardrailsAI
classes.description: Custom guardrail class integrating GuardrailsAI API validation into the Litellm framework, supporting pre-call, post-call, and logging hooks.

methods.name: GuardrailsAIResponse make_guardrails_ai_api_request( self, llm_output: str, request_data: dict )
methods.description: Sends a request to GuardrailsAI API with LLM output and request data, returns validation result or raises HTTPException on failure.

methods.name: str make_guardrails_ai_api_request_pre_call_request( self, text_input: str, request_data: dict )
methods.description: Sends input data for pre-call validation to GuardrailsAI API and retrieves validation status; note implementation caveats.

methods.name: dict process_input(self, data: dict, call_type: str)
methods.description: Processes message input for guardrail validation, based on configuration, updating message content accordingly.

methods.name: Optional[Union[Exception,str,dict]] async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: litellm.DualCache, data: dict, call_type: Literal[ "completion", "text_completion", "embeddings", "image_generation", "moderation", "audio_transcription", "pass_through_endpoint", "rerank", "mcp_call", ], )
methods.description: Pre-call hook that processes and validates the input asynchronously, raising exceptions or modifying data as needed.

methods.name: Tuple[dict,Any] async_logging_hook( self, kwargs: dict, result: Any, call_type: str )
methods.description: Logging hook that processes input data before logging, ensuring validation occurs.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Post-call hook to run after a successful API call, validating responses with GuardrailsAI.

methods.name: Optional[Type["GuardrailConfigModel"]] get_config_model()
methods.description: Static method returning the configuration model class for this guardrail.
